# Delivery Method

<!-- Generated from .ai/ by .ai/generators/compile.py. Do not edit directly. -->

Keep planning and integration in the primary context. For Hard work, define stop/rollback gates and obtain independent deep review.

Ground consequential decisions in repository evidence, relevant domain rules, and current authoritative sources. Retain only goals, invariants, boundaries, and unknowns that affect acceptance. Missing knowledge blocks only dependent work.

Make one plan with file scopes, success criteria, risks, and checks. Infer reversible details and continue ready work; ask only for decisions evidence cannot settle. Persist a plan only when requested.

Delegate only a bounded, independent task when isolation or parallelism repays the handoff cost. Supply `objective`, `file_scope`, `success_criteria`, `preserved_invariants`, `required_evidence`; stop on scope conflict, missing dependency, unsafe action, or contradicted assumption. Use fast reads, balanced implementation, and independent deep review when risk warrants. Do tightly coupled work inline.

Re-read the integrated diff, check invariants, and run the cheapest meaningful verification. Stop after sufficient evidence unless new failures or concerns justify more work. Store only recurring verified facts in project context.
